---
name: Cryptanalysis result
about: A distinguisher, an attack, or a flaw in a proof or an estimate
title: "[cryptanalysis] "
labels: cryptanalysis
---

**Target.** Component and profile (BRUME-512 at r rounds, AEAD mode, tree hash, Sillage-KEM, Sillage-SIG), and the claim it contradicts (section of `docs/PROOFS.md`, table of the README).

**Result.** What is distinguished or recovered, with which complexity (time, data, memory) and success probability.

**Reproduction.** Code, parameters, seeds, and the commit tested. Reduced-round or reduced-size results are welcome; please say how they are expected to scale.

**References.** Related published techniques, if any.
